features.name: Virtual Tables General Availability
features.description: Virtual tables achieve general availability in November, enabling inbound interaction from Dataverse into Business Central using native API without replicating data.
features.status_evidence_quote: I'd like to announce the first uh time General availability or GA that's coming this November for our virtual tables

features.name: Power Pages Support via Virtual Tables
features.description: Power Pages support for virtual tables enables access to Business Central data in three scenarios: anonymous access for external unlicensed users, authenticated access for external users after registration, and authenticated access for internal licensed users.
features.status_evidence_quote: a big feature that enabled our virtual tables which is the preview of Po Pages support that allow access to busy data from unlicensed
caveats: External users are those not in an employee relationship with the company
Internal users require Business Central licensing even when accessing via Power Pages

features.name: Data Change Events Performance Improvement
features.description: Data change events processing capacity increased from 100 to 1000 events per 30 seconds delay, controlled by server settings API subscription max number of notification and API subscription delay time.
caveats: These numbers are controlled by server settings and can be customized via extension

features.name: Business Events Filtering Support
features.description: Business events now support filtering with version 1.0, enhanced troubleshooting with external event subscription and external event activity log system tables, and event telemetry sent to Application Insights.
caveats: Troubleshooting UI pages coming in November 2023

features.name: Data Synchronization
features.description: Data sync replicates data changes whenever data is created, updated, or deleted between overlapping tables in Business Central and Dataverse, such as account table in Dataverse with vendor and customer tables in Business Central.
caveats: Improvements covered in part one of the session by Ivan

features.name: Business Events via Power Automate
features.description: Business events enable outbound interaction from Business Central to trigger Power Automate flows using when an action is performed trigger on Dataverse, allowing notifications when business actions occur.

features.name: Data Change Events via Power Automate
features.description: Data change events enable outbound interaction from Business Central, triggering Power Automate flows when data is created, updated, or deleted using when a row is added modified or deleted trigger.

features.name: Anonymous external user access via Power Pages
features.description: Enables unauthenticated users to register and browse products through Power Pages, creating native contact table entries in Dataverse without requiring a Business Central license.
caveats: Limited read access to items and products only
No sales order creation capability in anonymous mode

features.name: Authenticated external user sales order creation
features.description: Registered external users can authenticate and create sales orders through Power Pages, with orders immediately visible in Business Central.
caveats: Requires prior registration
Sales orders created through Power Pages appear in BC for processing

features.name: Microsoft Entra app users for BC data access
features.description: Three types of Entra app users enable different access patterns: virtual table impersonation, anonymous external access, and authenticated external access, each with configurable permission sets.
caveats: No permissions assigned by default
Admin must manually assign permission sets for activation
Wide permission scopes used in demo but narrow scope recommended for production

features.name: Virtual table synthetic relations
features.description: Allows native Dataverse tables (contacts) to be related to virtual tables (sales orders, invoices) using synthetic relations, enabling data filtering based on customer relationships.
caveats: Requires extending native contact table with new BC customer column
Synthetic relations need to be created separately for each virtual table
Dependent on Power Automate flow for data population

features.name: Power Automate-driven customer record creation
features.description: A Power Automate flow listens to contact table modifications and automatically creates corresponding customer records in Business Central under the specified company when new users register.
caveats: Requires data change events to be enabled on contact table
Flow must have access to default company setting for virtual tables

features.name: Business Events Versioning Support
features.description: Business events now support versioning which allows for different event payload versions. The demo shows version 1.0 which includes a new web client URL field compared to version 0.0 that only had an API URL.

features.name: External Event Subscription System Table
features.description: A system table called external event subscription that tracks all business event subscriptions created in the environment, showing subscription details and when they were created.
caveats: UI page for correlating subscriptions with activity log coming in November

features.name: Activity Lock System Table
features.description: A system table that tracks all business events being sent, showing when events are triggered and providing historical data for troubleshooting event delivery.
caveats: UI page for better visualization coming in November

features.name: Partner Telemetry for Business Events
features.description: Business event subscription and notification data is sent to Application Insights where partners can query and correlate event data with other business data for monitoring and troubleshooting.

features.name: Role-based Power Pages table permissions
features.description: Power Pages portal supports granular table permission configuration with different access levels (read, create, update) for various user types (anonymous, authenticated, administrator) at the table level.
caveats: Requires separate configuration for each table
Synthetic relations recommended to narrow data access further
